## About me

I hold a PhD in Probability and Statistics from the University of São Paulo (IME-USP), an MSc in Statistics and a BSc in Computational Mathematics from the Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG). I work as a data scientist and technical lead, with experience in credit risk modeling, model governance and statistical learning. I am good at translating complex business needs into data-driven solutions that are robust, explainable and auditable. I also teach data science at the graduate level. My interests include statistical learning, inference for stochastic processes and graphs.

Lattes CV (Brazilian academic CV, in Portuguese): [lattes.cnpq.br/9791024128849349](https://lattes.cnpq.br/9791024128849349).

### Professional experience

#### Senior Data Scientist — XP Inc (2025–present)

- I develop data-driven solutions for marketing and customer acquisition.
- I translate business needs into machine learning solutions.
- I teach internal data literacy training programs.

#### Graduate Lecturer — Insper (2021–present)

- I teach applied machine learning and statistical modeling in graduate and executive programs.
- Courses: Statistical Learning, Data Modeling, Neural Networks, Unsupervised Models, Transforming Business with Data.
- I am known for presenting technical content clearly to diverse audiences.

#### Senior Statistical Modeling Analyst — Pefisa (2024–2025)

- Proposed and led the implementation of a unified modeling base and an internal feature store, with more than 150 engineered features, cutting development time by one week per model.
- Designed and led the implementation of an automation framework for model monitoring, reducing monthly effort from 80 to 4 hours.
- Improved the personal loan admission model by 11 KS percentage points through redesign and feature engineering.
- Served as the technical reference for the modeling team.
- Delivered solutions for Credit Risk, Credit Policy, Collections, Financial Products, Marketing and CRM.

#### Pricing Specialist — Banco BTG Pactual (2022–2024)

- Led the pricing workstream in the portfolio management team.
- Implemented derivative pricing models for portfolio management.
- Automated data pipelines, saving 2 hours a day per team member.
- Led the development of a generative AI application to analyze the impact of news on the portfolio.

- **MSc in Statistics** — DEST-UFMG (2016–2018)  
  Dissertation: [Extending JAGS for spatial data](https://repositorio.ufmg.br/bitstream/1843/BUOS-AZGNHV/1/dissertacao_magno_t_f_severino.pdf)
